enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Adamantine: Found only in meteorites and the rarest of veins in magical areas, this ultrahard metal adds to the quality of a weapon or suit of armor. Weapons made of adamantine have the ability to bypass the protective damage reduction of certain monsters.
Impact: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
Stunning +10: +10 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist attempts.
Bleed: This weapon is cruelly sharp and will do an additional 1 to 8 damage to targets that are vulnerable to bleeding.
Maladroit: This weapon afflicts enemies with sluggish and clumsy movements. -1 Dexterity on a successful hit.

Upgradeable Item (Stormreaver): This item could be upgraded if you found a Seal of the Stormreaver to combine it with. Bring this item to the Stormreaver Monument in Gianthold and combine it with a Seal of the Stormreaver to upgrade the item to a more powerful form.

children.tooltip: Bone Breaking: Critical hits by this weapon deal an extra 1 to 6 points of Dexterity damage by shattering the bones of its target.
Spikes: The sharp spikes on this item deal an additional 1 to 6 Piercing damage when used to strike an enemy.

enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
